tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Homotopy of paths is an equivalence relation]

↗ def:homotopy-of-paths

1. ch1:1.2\group Fundamental Group

Homotopy is an equivalence relation on paths with fixed endpoints.

Proof

\sketch Reflexivity uses the constant homotopy, symmetry reverses the parameter, and transitivity concatenates two homotopies in the $t$-coordinate. Continuity of the concatenated homotopy follows from the pasting lemma.

□
